brief:
Palestinian factions are exploring a unified electoral alliance ahead of November elections, according to Al Jazeera English. Hamas and a breakaway Fatah faction are considering a joint electoral list as part of broader coalition-building efforts that could reshape Palestinian politics and challenge incumbent leader Mahmoud Abbas. The potential alliance represents a significant realignment among Palestinian movements that have historically remained divided.

The electoral strategy reflects shifting dynamics within Palestinian political movements as the November calendar approaches. A unified candidacy among previously fractious groups would consolidate opposition against Abbas's dominance in Palestinian governance. Negotiations among the factions remain ongoing, with the scope and structure of any final alliance still under discussion.
dek: Hamas, breakaway Fatah faction consider unified electoral list to challenge Mahmoud Abbas as political landscape shifts.
title: Hamas and Fatah splinter pursue joint electoral challenge to Abbas
